deal.product_description: Eco‑Worthy 12V LiFePO4 battery rated at 3584Wh (280Ah) designed for off‑grid solar systems and backup power. The battery offers high usable capacity in a comparatively compact, lower‑weight LiFePO4 chemistry suited for deep‑cycle applications and longer cycle life than lead‑acid alternatives. It's intended for serious loads and energy storage in residential or remote setups.

Certified refurbished Samsung Galaxy S23+ with 512GB storage and 8GB RAM, unlocked for use on compatible carriers. The phone includes a 50MP rear camera system, under‑display fingerprint sensor, and is graded in Good condition (may show visible scratches or dents). Sold with a one‑year Allstate warranty and free shipping.

Philips 100" 4K QLED+ Google Smart TV featuring a 100-inch QLED+ 4K UHD (2160p) panel for large-room viewing. The set runs Google TV, giving access to thousands of apps and built-in Google Assistant, includes Bluetooth and 802.11ac Wi‑Fi connectivity, and offers a selection of free live TV channels. Designed for cinematic-scale content with smart platform integration and modern connectivity for streaming and casting.

The Anker SOLIX C1000X is a portable power station with a 1,056 watt-hour lithium battery designed for home backup and off-grid use. It offers up to 2,400W surge output to run high-draw appliances, 11 output ports including multiple AC outlets and USB-C, and fast full recharging via AC in about 58 minutes. The unit is rated for more than 3,000 battery cycles and includes UPS-style switchover under 20 milliseconds for reliable backup power.

Hisense QD50 58" 4K QLED UHD Smart TV is a 58-inch 4K display that uses QLED color technology and supports Dolby Vision, HDR10, and HLG for enhanced contrast and color. It includes an AI 4K upscaler to improve lower-resolution content and gaming-friendly features like variable refresh rate and auto low latency mode. The set runs the Roku TV platform for access to streaming apps and services built into the television.
